description: This file defines the NatsAdapter class which implements the IQueueAdapter interface for integrating NATS streaming into Orleans streaming infrastructure. It provides methods for creating receivers and queuing message batches using NATS connection manager and serializer.

classes.name: NatsAdapter
classes.description: An internal sealed class implementing IQueueAdapter for NATS streaming, managing message sending and receiver creation.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates and returns a new NatsQueueAdapterReceiver for the specified queue.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously enqueues a batch of messages to NATS stream using the connection manager.
